task: Extend Sentinel with general integrity divergence correlation across existing Control Plane authorities and evidence.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: Sentinel currently observes workflow trends, Failure Intake and Deep Atlas attention, but it does not generically correlate contradictions between declared truth, authority, proof semantics, transaction identity, coverage and downstream execution. The just-closed Control Plane repair proved that status laundering, provenance drift, deletion blindness, evidence/workflow disagreement and semantic proof drift can coexist while individual controls look locally valid.
observableOutcomes: Sentinel evaluates a normalized integrity model that can report authority, provenance, decision, coverage and proof-semantics divergence without hard-coding one PR or defect number.
A child BLOCK, failed artifact, stale transaction identity or incomplete coverage can never be interpreted by Sentinel as a healthy integrity state when the surrounding workflow reports success.

Sentinel correlates the existing Guard Registry and active Completion Contract so unknown evidence references, capability mismatch, scope overclaim and missing proof dimensions become explicit integrity findings.
Sentinel keeps the existing Deep Atlas authority boundary intact: architecture findings are consumed as existing evidence rather than replaced by a second Atlas or blocking gate.
The daily Sentinel workflow executes the integrity probe before trend correlation and a missing or UNKNOWN probe remains visible instead of silently producing HEALTHY.
Sentinel remains observation-only, cannot mutate code, cannot merge, and cannot override Control Plane, Atlas, Failure Intake, Release Risk or Completion Truth authority.
unresolvedRisks: Daily observation can only correlate evidence that is available on main or normalized into the Sentinel probe; feature-branch defects still rely on the existing change-time Control Plane until merged.
Generic evidence schemas must avoid guessing semantics from human prose, otherwise broad anomaly detection could create false positive authority conflicts.
Not every existing guard exposes a JSON artifact or full proof semantics, so missing evidence must remain visible without falsely claiming that every absence is a product defect.
The integrity probe must stay computationally cheap and deterministic because Sentinel runs daily and must not become a duplicate full CI or Deep Atlas execution.

in: Existing Shoperation Sentinel scan, policy and scheduled workflow.
A Sentinel-internal integrity correlator that consumes existing authority declarations and normalized evidence without gaining blocking authority.
Guard dependency/responsibility coherence, active Completion Contract proof semantics, exact-state provenance, decision monotonicity, deletion visibility and coverage completeness.
Fail-visible UNKNOWN behavior and adversarial tests for the generic divergence classes exposed by the latest Control Plane repair.
out: Any new blocking CI gate, release authority, Atlas authority, Failure Intake authority or autonomous repair system.
Re-running the full Deep Atlas or complete regression suite inside the daily Sentinel workflow.
Free-text contradiction inference or automatic mutation of rules, code, plans, Known Failures or evidence.
Product/storefront/template changes unrelated to Sentinel integrity observation.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: This change observes the self-consistency of the system that decides whether development evidence is trustworthy. The practical ceiling is therefore a normalized, fail-visible correlation layer with adversarial proofs for known contradiction classes, while reusing existing authorities rather than duplicating their decisions or turning Sentinel into another blocker.

acceptanceCriteria: A synthetic parent PASS containing a child BLOCK is reported as an ACTION integrity finding and cannot yield a HEALTHY Sentinel report.
A workflow success paired with a machine-readable artifact BLOCK is reported as decision laundering rather than accepted as successful evidence.
Declared base/head provenance that is unresolved or differs from evaluated base/head is reported as transaction identity drift.
A delete-only material change omitted from an observer change set is reported as deletion visibility drift.
Coverage truncation or observed coverage smaller than declared expected coverage is reported explicitly and cannot be hidden by a PASS decision.
Completion Contract evidence references are checked against the existing Guard Registry for guard existence, required capability, proof strength and required dimensions.
Duplicate blocking responsibility, unknown guard dependency and dependency cycles are reported from the existing Guard Registry without creating another registry.
Missing or UNKNOWN integrity-probe evidence makes Sentinel REVIEW-visible; it never silently collapses to HEALTHY.
The scheduled workflow runs the integrity probe and the existing Sentinel scan remains observation-only with autoMutationAllowed=false.
invariants: Sentinel observes and correlates authority outputs but never becomes the authority that defines their domain truth.
Integrity classification is based on structured machine-readable fields and registry contracts, never inferred from human prose.
Blocking child truth is monotonic for observation: downstream PASS cannot erase BLOCK, FAIL, STALE, UNRESOLVED or UNKNOWN evidence.
Exact-state provenance is part of evidence identity; a different base, head, branch or state cannot be treated as equivalent without explicit proof.
Expected coverage and deletions are first-class integrity dimensions; missing observation is not equivalent to absence of change.
One blocking responsibility has one owner and guard dependency relationships must remain resolvable and acyclic.
UNKNOWN remains visible and conservative; Sentinel may recommend deeper verification but may not manufacture PASS.

failureModes: A specialist artifact records BLOCK while the wrapper or workflow reports success and trend-only Sentinel sees a healthy run.
Two blocking guards accidentally share one responsibility or a guard dependency points to an unknown/cyclic owner.
A Completion Contract keeps an evidence ID after its Guard Registry proof capability or dimensions change.
A transaction is evaluated on a different base/head than the evidence metadata claims.
A delete-only change or truncated Reference Sync candidate set disappears from a downstream observer while decision remains PASS.
The integrity probe itself fails or is missing and the trend scan interprets lack of evidence as health.
Architecture drift is reimplemented in Sentinel instead of being consumed from existing Atlas/Deep Atlas authority.
Development branch noise is promoted to canonical platform-health action without main/scheduled evidence.
edgeCases: No active Completion Contract requirement references a guard with detailed proof semantics.
A referenced guard uses wildcard capability but low scope strength.
Multiple evidence producers jointly cover required dimensions while no single producer covers all dimensions.
An evidence record has no child decisions and therefore must not invent a monotonicity conflict.
Expected deletion set is empty and must not create a false deletion warning.
Coverage expected and observed counts are equal exactly at a supported implementation bound.
A nonblocking observation signal depends on a blocking guard and must not become a second blocker.
Current closed plan verified head is an ancestor of main but later metadata-only commits exist.

alternatives.summary: Extend the existing Sentinel with a normalized integrity correlator and daily probe that reuse current Control Plane authorities.
alternatives.reason: It detects cross-authority contradictions at the observation layer without adding a new blocking owner or duplicating Atlas and Completion Truth logic.

alternatives.summary: Create a new blocking Integrity Gate after the existing Control Plane chain and make it the final release decision.
alternatives.reason: It would duplicate authority, add another place for rule disagreement, and recreate the exact parallel-gate problem this work is meant to prevent.

alternatives.summary: Teach Sentinel only the concrete pingpong, Reference Sync and proof-semantic symptoms observed in the most recent repair.
alternatives.reason: Concrete signatures would miss the next structurally equivalent defect when filenames, guards or workflows change, leaving detection dependent on manual discovery again.

specialistReviews.finding: Sentinel already owns observation and recommendation, while Atlas, Control Plane and Completion Truth own their respective truth decisions.
specialistReviews.resolution: Keep integrity work inside SIGNAL-SENTINEL and consume structured authority outputs; do not add another guard or authority node.

specialistReviews.finding: Treating a missing probe as clean would recreate evidence laundering because absence of integrity evidence would become implicit PASS.
specialistReviews.resolution: Model missing or malformed probe evidence as UNKNOWN/REVIEW-visible and reserve HEALTHY for positively evaluated clean integrity evidence.

specialistReviews.finding: Running full CI or Deep Atlas again inside Sentinel would be expensive and duplicate existing scheduled verification.
specialistReviews.resolution: Use a cheap deterministic probe over current registry/plan plus normalized evidence and continue consuming existing Deep Atlas attention separately.

specialistReviews.finding: The recurring class is not one pingpong signature but disagreement between evidence identity, decision propagation, coverage and claimed proof semantics.
specialistReviews.resolution: Adversarial tests target generic structured contradiction classes so future equivalent defects are detected despite different files or guard names.

challenge.scenario: A child guard emits BLOCK but a composite parent record says PASS.
challenge.finding: Trend-only observation can accept the wrapper status and miss a real internal contradiction.
challenge.resolution: Integrity correlation inspects structured child decisions and emits status-laundering ACTION evidence.

challenge.scenario: A workflow step is successful while its producer artifact records BLOCK or FAIL.
challenge.finding: Workflow status is weaker than producer truth and can launder a failed specialist decision.
challenge.resolution: When both structured decisions exist, disagreement is an explicit decision-integrity finding.

challenge.scenario: Evidence claims one base or head while the evaluated transaction resolves to another identity.
challenge.finding: A green proof may describe a different code state than the one actually tested.
challenge.resolution: Declared and evaluated transaction identities are compared structurally and unresolved explicit identity stays visible.

challenge.scenario: A delete-only change is absent from the observer file set while decision remains PASS.
challenge.finding: Deletion blindness can jointly hide material change from later evidence consumers.
challenge.resolution: Integrity records compare declared deleted files with observed material files and report omissions.

challenge.scenario: Reference coverage is silently truncated or observed count is lower than expected while the record says PASS.
challenge.finding: Incomplete proof can masquerade as complete coverage and reproduce silent Reference Sync truncation.
challenge.resolution: Coverage mismatch or explicit truncation produces an integrity finding independent of the outer PASS label.

challenge.scenario: A Completion Contract references a guard whose capabilities, strength or dimensions no longer prove the claim.
challenge.finding: Registry evolution can make previously valid evidence semantically stale without changing the evidence ID.
challenge.resolution: Sentinel correlates current Guard Registry proof semantics against active claim scope and reports semantic drift.

challenge.scenario: Guard dependencies form a cycle or reference a missing guard after registry edits.
challenge.finding: Execution ordering becomes contradictory even though every guard entry may be locally well formed.
challenge.resolution: Sentinel performs a registry graph coherence correlation and reports missing nodes or cycles without owning the graph.

challenge.scenario: The integrity probe cannot run or its report is missing on a day with otherwise successful workflows.
challenge.finding: No evidence could be misread as no problem, recreating a false HEALTHY state.
challenge.resolution: The scan treats missing, malformed or UNKNOWN integrity evidence as REVIEW-visible and recommends deeper verification.

challenge.scenario: Deep Atlas already reports architecture drift and Sentinel independently reimplements the same classifier.
challenge.finding: Two architecture authorities could disagree and produce another pingpong source.
challenge.resolution: Sentinel consumes existing Deep Atlas attention and keeps the new correlator focused on cross-evidence integrity, not architecture reclassification.

proofPlan: Create the normalized Sentinel integrity evaluator as a pure module and adversarially test each contradiction class with synthetic structured evidence.
Add a daily integrity probe that reads the existing Guard Registry and active Development Plan, producing observation evidence without mutating either authority.
Correlate Completion Contract evidence references with current guard proof semantics and prove missing capability, insufficient strength and missing dimensions remain visible.
Prove child BLOCK versus parent PASS and artifact BLOCK versus workflow success both yield action-level integrity findings.
Prove transaction base/head mismatch, deletion omission and coverage truncation are detected without relying on concrete PR numbers or filenames.
Prove duplicate blocking responsibility, unknown guard dependency and dependency cycles are detected from the existing registry structure.
Wire the probe into the existing Shoperation Sentinel schedule and make missing/UNKNOWN probe evidence produce REVIEW rather than HEALTHY.
Retain existing main/development scope classification so iterative feature failures alone do not become canonical ACTION_REQUIRED.
Run Sentinel tests plus full Quality, TypeScript and Production Build on the exact branch head before Completion Truth and lifecycle closure.

requirements.requirement: Sentinel detects structured cross-authority integrity divergence without hard-coded defect identities or a new blocking authority.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Child BLOCK, artifact BLOCK, stale identity or incomplete coverage cannot be observed as clean integrity.

requirements.requirement: Sentinel correlates active Completion Contract claims with current Guard Registry capabilities, strength and proof dimensions.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Unknown evidence IDs or semantic proof drift cannot silently remain HEALTHY.

requirements.requirement: Missing, malformed or UNKNOWN integrity-probe evidence remains operator-visible and never collapses into a HEALTHY daily Sentinel state.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: A missing or UNKNOWN integrity probe cannot produce HEALTHY.

requirements.requirement: The Sentinel integrity extension typechecks and production-builds on the exact implementation head without changing blocking authority.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: No type or production build regression is introduced by the Sentinel integrity extension.

notes: Follow-up after the closed #681 Control Plane coherence repair. This transaction strengthens the existing Sentinel observation layer so newly introduced integrity divergence is discovered automatically where structured evidence exists. It does not create a new gate or autonomous repair authority. Plan-only CI derived projected subsystems quality-infrastructure + release-infrastructure and canonical guard digest efe9d183. New planned files are intentionally not placed in semantic MUST_EDIT before they exist in Atlas; they remain explicit plannedFilePatterns and will become actual tracked files during implementation.
